instrument.isolation: test-only transparent wrappers around the unchanged writer; no product edit
instrument.progress: bounded periodic JSON every 8192 add events; atomic temp replace; no per-row verbose output
instrument.partial_cap: progress persisted during run; incomplete spans remain incomplete and are not inferred

derived_buckets.proof_residual_not_pure_sql: build_sourcefree_direct_i02 elapsed minus sink/add and index/add inclusive; includes validation, inserts, hashes and SQLite overhead, NOT pure SQL
derived_buckets.writer_residual_after_proof_verify: write_direct_estate elapsed minus proof and verify; includes setup, hashing, fsync and publication

nesting_limits: _Sink.add includes _Sink.flush; flush duration is nested and must not be added again.
build_sourcefree_direct_i02 includes tap/_Sink/_IndexSink consumption and proof work; residual is not pure SQL.
write_direct_estate includes proof and verify; post-proof residual is not a single stage.
If cap kills the process, only completed calls/spans and periodic progress survive; no final residual is fabricated.
later_constraints: unique new owned output root; never mutate preserved .local-data-width512 stage
sourcefree only; no native source/query/build beyond this writer
supervision must enforce caps and retain progress on SIGTERM
not_run: no actual writer build in this turn
